description: This file implements the RemoveSource class, which is responsible for removing a media source (specifically of type AUDIO) in a media playback context. It handles clearing buffers, updating state flags, and sending flush events to the media source element.

classes.name: RemoveSource
classes.description: A class that handles the removal of a media source of type AUDIO, including flushing the source element and updating internal state.

methods.name: RemoveSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RemoveSource object with context, client, wrapper, and media source type.

methods.name: ~RemoveSource
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of RemoveSource.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the removal of the media source, including clearing buffers, updating flags, and sending flush events to the source element.
